title: VALCON: Benchmarking and Enhancing Value Consistency in Large Language Models via Dual-Role Variation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current value alignment evaluations for large language models (LLMs) heavily rely on output compliance, overlooking whether LLMs maintain value consistency when alternating between generator and evaluator roles. Such consistency is increasingly important because modern LLM agents and alignment pipelines often rely on the same LLM to both generate actions and evaluate their acceptability. To mitigate this limitation, we propose VALCON, a role-driven data construction framework that operationalizes value consistency into three benchmark suites (VAB-Consistency, VAB-Boundary, VAB-Challenge) via dual-role variation. By systematically pairing an LLM's generative behavior with its evaluative judgments under identical principles, VALCON synthesizes target evaluation data that exposes hidden value discrepancies. translated_title: VALCON：通过双角色变体对大语言模型的价值一致性进行基准测试与增强
translated_abstract: 当前针对大语言模型（LLM）的价值对齐评估严重依赖于输出合规性，忽视了LLM在生成器与评估器角色之间切换时能否保持价值一致性。这种一致性正变得越来越重要，因为现代LLM智能体和对齐流程通常依赖同一个LLM既生成动作，又评估这些动作的可接受性。为了缓解这一局限，我们提出了VALCON——一个角色驱动的数据构建框架，通过双角色变体将价值一致性操作化为三个基准套件（VAB-Consistency、VAB-Boundary、VAB-Challenge）。通过在相同原则下系统地将LLM的生成行为与其评估判断进行配对，VALCON合成了能够暴露隐藏价值差异的目标评估数据。在28个大语言模型上的实验揭示了普遍存在的跨角色不一致性：输出高度合规的模型经常无法使其评估判断（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了VALCON框架，通过双角色变体将LLM的价值一致性操作化为三个基准套件，对28个模型的实验揭示了大语言模型在生成器与评估器角色之间存在普遍的价值不一致现象。
en_tdlr: VALCON is a role-driven framework that operationalizes LLM value consistency into three benchmark suites via dual-role variation, revealing pervasive cross-role inconsistency across 28 LLMs, where models with highly compliant outputs often fail to align their evaluative judgments.
